sources.label: Clinic reminder for follow-up visit
sources.note: Owner supplied the reminder text and asked for a private prep packet.

sources.label: Discharge instruction excerpt supplied by owner
Owner notes for questions and logistics

concerns.label: Owner-reported energy change
concerns.ownerReported: Owner noted lower energy since the prior visit and wants to ask the clinician how to discuss it.

concerns.label: Urgency boundary note
concerns.ownerReported: Owner wants the packet to preserve that urgent or worsening symptoms should be handled by qualified humans or emergency services, not this packet.

medications.label: Medication list to review with clinician
medications.ownerReported: Owner supplied the current list and wants to ask whether it is still accurate at the visit.

priorInstructions.label: Bring discharge instruction excerpt for review

logistics.note: Reminder says to review arrival instructions privately before leaving.
Owner noted a caregiver may attend, but sharing scope must be confirmed by the owner.

reviewQuestions.question: Which medication-list items should the owner ask the clinician to review for accuracy?
reviewQuestions.reason: The packet has a current owner-supplied list, but any medication, treatment, dose, urgency, billing, portal, or insurance decision stays outside this artifact.

reviewQuestions.question: Which supplied documents should the owner review before the visit and decide whether to bring?
reviewQuestions.reason: The reminder and discharge note identify possible visit materials, but the owner controls disclosure and any portal or provider communication.

handoff.summary: Owner-reviewed follow-up packet with supplied appointment reminder, medication-list freshness, prior instruction excerpt, document checklist, logistics notes, clinician questions, and unresolved caregiver-sharing scope.
blockedActions: No diagnosis, triage, treatment recommendation, medication change, dosage advice, urgency decision, or emergency determination
No scheduling, provider messaging, portal submission, record upload, account change, payment, billing handling, or insurance claim action
No disclosure of protected health information beyond owner-approved review
